item.title: Satsuma-age Fish Cake — Guide
item.description: Satsuma-age is one of Kagoshima’s most famous foods, a deep-fried cake of ground fish paste that originated in the old Satsuma domain (now Kagoshima) and spread across Japan. Fresh fish is minced into a paste, blended with local sweet potato starch and a touch of sweetness (and often a splash of local shochu), shaped and deep-fried until golden, giving a savoury, slightly sweet, springy and satisfying result quite different from steamed kamaboko fish cake.
